$comment: Input of scripts/import-yarns.mjs (DESIGN.md §5.6 'Yarn data'). Every line needs a complete provenance record and a licence on the allowlist; the script refuses anything else. Inputs are pinned by sha256.

provenance.licenseStatement: LICENSE-DATA.md: "The files in data/ are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0)." The file's own "license" field is "CC-BY-4.0"; SOURCES.md lists red-heart-super-saver as CC-BY-4.0 and outside the MIT exception (perler-midi, hama-midi, artkal-s, nabbi). npm craft-color-codes@1.0.0 declares (MIT AND CC-BY-4.0).
provenance.attribution: Color data: craft-color-codes by MakeBead (https://makebead.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
provenance.changes: Converted to the app's YarnLine format: hex lowercased, ids and line metadata added, skein sizes added from the maker's product page, heathers flagged textured. Names, numbers and colors unchanged.
provenance.notes: Upstream status 'approximate': codes and names checked against the Yarnspirations catalogue (2026-07-06); colors are uncalibrated approximations.
